title.narrative: OBSERVATORY ON ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IN EDUCATION FOR LAC

description.narrative:
Artificial intelligence is rapidly transforming the technological landscape in which education systems operate. New forms of generative and adaptive technologies are already influencing how students access information, how teachers design learning experiences, and how governments consider the governance of digital technologies in schools and universities. While the emergence of artificial intelligence offers significant opportunities to support teaching and learning, it also raises complex policy questions related to ethics, governance, inclusion, and the equitable design of technologies.
Governments in Latin America and the Caribbean are increasingly seeking trusted multilateral platforms capable of generating evidence, supporting integrated policy development, and mobilizing the investments and reforms necessary to ensure that digital transformation in education serves all learners — especially those at greatest risk of being left behind.
In this context, UNESCO Santiago is leading the establishment of the Regional Observatory on Artificial Intelligence in Education in Latin America and the Caribbean. This strategic initiative will serve as a multi-actor platform to generate evidence on the use of AI in education, formulate evidence-based policy recommendations on responsible use of AI, develop technical and pedagogical capacities among key actors (teachers, administrators, policymakers and students) and maintain a regional technical dialogue that strengthens the generation of AI knowledge from and for our region. In this way, it will contribute to advancing SDG 4 – Quality Education, promoting educational innovation and digital transformation while leaving no one behind.
